Specification: This specification is a small test module for unfolding a recursive definition, specifically the Fibonacci function. It defines a recursive operator Fib over integers, uses it to initialize a state variable f to Fib(4), and then updates f in the next-state action to Fib(5). The module also states a simple invariant requiring that f >= 1, and it includes explicit unrolling-control definitions for the recursive operator.
IfThenElse: IF n <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE IF n <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE Fib(n - 2) + Fib(n - 1)
IF n <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE Fib(n - 2) + Fib(n - 1)
